resources.purpose: The d10 tables from the rulebook's Fictional Army Generator for Pick-up Games: force matchups, period and theater, brigades and batteries per division, exceptional leaders, brigade strength, experience, morale bands, and weapons. Random armies roll on these tables.
resources.whenMissing: Random-army generation stops and names the folders it checked. Fixed-roster labels still work, because they need only the bundled effectiveness table.
resources.howToObtain: Photograph or scan the Fictional Army Generator pages in your own copy of Brigade Fire and Fury 2nd Edition. The agent reads the photos and fills the templates in assets/table-templates, then checks them with scripts/Test-BrigadeTables.ps1.
